meta.title: HALO | Wireless Headphones for Deep Listening
meta.description: HALO One are wireless over-ear headphones with adaptive noise cancelling, spatial audio, and 40 hours of battery life. Designed for people who listen with intent, they read the space around you in real time, tune themselves to your ears, and turn everyday noise into focused, immersive sound.

who._info: Section Who it's for. Sur desktop, chaque paragraphe est coupé en deux lignes (text1_start = 1re ligne, text1_end = la suite) ; sur mobile, les deux morceaux sont recollés.
who.intro:
Some sounds need silence around them to be heard.
Listening with intent creates focus, presence, and a deeper connection with music. Halo is built around that simple truth.
who.label: Who it's for:
who.text1_start: This is made for people who truly listen. It
who.text1_end: keeps the world quiet and the sound honest, so you can stay inside your music or your work without noise in the way.
who.text2_start: Everything adapts through the app, where
who.text2_end: your sound is tuned to your ears and adjusts on its own to every place you go.

audience1.title: Commuters & Travelers
audience1.text: Trains, planes, and busy streets fade into the background. Adaptive noise cancelling reacts to every change around you, so a long commute becomes quiet time — for music, podcasts, or simply a moment to think.

audience2.title: Musicians, Creators & Producers
audience2.text: Detail matters when you make sound. Tuned drivers and a neutral profile let you hear mixes as they are, while low-latency mode keeps audio and video in sync. Everything you hear is honest, precise, and ready to shape into something bigger — without breaking the flow.

audience3.title: Remote Workers & Teams
audience3.text: Meetings start anywhere and stay clear. Eight microphones isolate your voice from cafés and keyboards, while multipoint switches between laptop and phone on its own — keeping your attention in the conversation, not on the noise.

paper._info: Section noire à cartes empilées. slide1 = la 1re carte qu'on voit en scrollant (elle s'affiche avec le visuel « Slide 1 » de la checklist).
paper.heading: your world

slide1.title:
We listen to your space
before you hear
anything
slide1.subtitle: For the system, noise is a map
slide1.text: Eight microphones measure the sound around you thousands of times per second, mapping every hum, voice, and gust of wind. For you, the world simply goes quiet. For the system, it becomes a constant reference that shapes the noise cancelling in real time.

slide2.title:
Feels like silence.
Works like a system.
slide2.subtitle: For you, it’s just quiet
slide2.text: You press play and everything else fades. No settings to hunt for, no modes to switch between. The cushions seal softly, the sound stays clean, and nothing pulls you out of the moment. Nothing changes in how you listen — only how deep you can go.

slide3.title:
No hiss. No pressure.
No random dropouts.
slide3.subtitle: AI-powered sound
slide3.text: Audio is processed in real time and refined quietly in the background. AI recognizes voices, music, and places to balance noise cancelling, sharpen dialogue, and protect your hearing. The technology stays invisible, so your focus stays on sound.

slide4.title:
Your sound profile is synced
to every device you own
slide4.subtitle: Your settings. Already there.
slide4.text: Your personal EQ and hearing profile follow you from phone to laptop to tablet. Switch devices mid-song without pairing again, keep your presets in one place, and pick up where you left off. Your listening becomes part of a system that is personal, consistent, and always ready.

inside._info: Section Inside the box. title_gray = le mot en gris du titre.
inside.title: the box

box.title: A complete, ready-to-use set
box.text: Halo One headphones, travel case, USB-C cable, and audio cable — carefully packaged for an effortless start.

inside.description: Wireless over-ear headphones with a machined aluminum frame, designed for long listening sessions and honest, detailed sound. Seamlessly connects to all your devices and adapts to every space you move through — no cables, no noise, just music.

item1.title: The HALO Headphones
item1.text:
Aluminum frame, USB-C charging, physical noise control button, and Bluetooth 5.4.
Up to 40 hours of listening with a lightweight, balanced design for all-day wear.

item2.title: Travel Case
item2.text:
Compact hard-shell case with a magnetic closure.
Folds the headphones flat and protects them on every trip.
